title: Duplicate Execution Replay Stays Idempotent
description: The client loses the response after the host already finished a task, so it replays the approval request for the same task and patch. The daemon must accept the retry without re-running the preset or duplicating the evidence node.

injected_fault.detail: Replay approve_and_execute_task for an already completed task

user_prompt: I did not get the completion response. Retry the approval for the same task and confirm the result.
forbidden_hallucinations: claiming a second experiment was executed
reporting two different MAE values for one task

ground_truth_assertions.description: The replayed approval answers with the already-started execution handle instead of re-running
Only one evidence node exists for the task after the replay
The replay does not modify the user main working tree
